Leading today’s Green Deals pack is the ENGWE Black Friday/Cyber Monday deals on the Eagle Electric Dirt Bike with a $276 bundle at a new $799 low , as well as the M20 3.0 Moped-Style e-bike with a $347 bundle starting from $1,399 . We also spotted Anker’s eufy Wall Light Cam S4 and its 2-pack at new lows from $150 , the latest Greenworks 24V 12-inch Cordless Snow Shovel with a first-time discount, Bluetti’s exclusive Alternator Charger 1 and Alternator and Solar Charger 2 savings, and more waiting below. We’ve also got the deals from the last two days at the bottom of the page, including yesterday’s EcoFlow TITAN 5000 Classic solar bundle flash offer that ends tonight, the Hiboy Black Friday EV lineup , and others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
ENGWE offers up to $676 Black Friday savings: M20 3.0 moped-style e-bike + $347 bundle from $1,399, more
ENGWE has its Black Friday/Cyber Monday deals running at full speed, which focus on two particular models, while plenty of others are seeing ongoing discounts. Alongside the latest Eagle Electric Dirt Bike low price , my top pick of the two has to be the 2026 M20 3.0 Moped-Style e-bike, with its single-battery configuration down at $1,399 shipped , and its dual-battery configuration down at $1,699 shipped . Not only are you getting $200 and $300 discounts from their $1,599 and $1,999 full prices, but they both come with a FREE bundle of gear alongside an extended two-year warranty ($347 total value). These prices have only been beaten by past discounts to $1,349 and $1,649 at the start of summer, giving you the second-lowest overall prices since releasing in March. You can browse all the brand’s non-Black Friday e-bike discounts here .
Pick up Anker’s latest HomeKit-ready solar Wall Light Cam S4 or a 2-pack at new lows from $150
While Anker’s direct eufy Early Black Friday security deals are filled with some of the best prices of the year, the brand’s official Amazon storefront is actually undercutting the sale when it comes to the Anker eufy Wall Light Solar Security Cam S4 2-Pack at $299.98 shipped . This deal beats out the direct website’s pricing by $100 , with the discount here dropping things from a $450 full price by $150. Since it released in September, we’ve only seen price cuts to $406, $380, and $376, but now you’re able to score a larger-than-ever discount that lands things at a new all-time low. Of course, if you instead only need one, you can grab a single Wall Light Cam S4 for $149.99 shipped , which is also a new all-time low.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Greenworks’ latest 24V 12-inch cordless electric snow shovel kit gets first discount to $180 low (Reg. $230)
Amazon is offering the first chance at savings on the latest Greenworks 24V 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel with a 4.0Ah battery down at $179.99 shipped . Only on the market for a little over a month with a $230 full price, this new smaller-voltage model is dropping down by $50 here. The 22% markdown is the first we’ve seen, with the deal providing you a new low price just ahead of winter’s arrival.
Upgrade to Bluetti’s 560W Charger 1 or the 1,200W dual Charger 2 with exclusive savings starting from $209
As part of Bluetti’s continuing early Black Friday power station deals , it’s a solid time for travelers to upgrade their vehicles with one of the brand’s on-the-go charging methods. The starting option is the Alternator Charger 1 down at $208.55 shipped , after using the exclusive code 9TO5TOYS5OFF at checkout, beating out Amazon by $10 . Down from $249 to $219, our exclusive savings code will shave an additional $10 savings for you. We’ve consistently seen this model down at this rate throughout 2026, with it only having been beaten out this year by two short-term falls to $199 during both Prime Day events. Of course, for a more advanced setup, you can find the Alternator & Solar Dual DC Charger 2 down at $407.55 shipped , after using the above code, beating out Amazon by $41 .
